Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - HealthBridge Insurance

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the Redwood demo. I appreciate you and Sophie running through your current workflows — helpful context. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan attached.

What we covered:
- Demo highlights: streaming chat for agent assist, embeddings-based retrieval for historical claims, and cost/latency profiles for dedicated vs hosted.
- Primary goals you called out: 1) reduce agent handle time on claims triage; 2) surface accurate historical precedents for adjudication; 3) meet data residency/SOC2 constraints for test data.

Proposed 4-week POC (attached as "POC-outline-HealthBridge.pdf"):
1) Week 0 (Prep) — network & access, sample dataset ingestion (anonymized claims), SRE/infra checklist.
2) Week 1 — baseline evaluation: run existing queries + Redwood out-of-box settings.
3) Week 2 — tuning: prompt/embedding configuration, caching & batching settings; integrate with your triage UI (sample endpoints).
4) Week 3 — evaluation & handoff: measure handle-time delta, precision@K on retrieval tasks, error analysis and QA.

Success criteria (proposed):
- >=20% reduction in average agent handle time on prioritized flows (sample size >=200 interactions)
- >=10% improvement in precision@5 for retrieval of relevant past claims
- End-to-end latency for UI calls <600ms P95 (on Dedicated config)

Next steps:
- I attached the POC outline and a draft SLA and network checklist for your security and infra teams. Can you confirm owners for data access and a preferred kickoff week?

Thanks — I can be flexible the week of Mar 8 or Mar 15 for kickoff.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Tom — great questions. Answers below and I've looped in Rishi (SE) and Neha (CS) for the technical and program coordination items.

1) Measuring agent handle time: we typically ask for either (a) CRM logs with timestamps for interaction start/end, or (b) synthetic session recordings if logs are unavailable. For a short POC, the CRM logs are ideal because they give you a clean baseline. We'll provide a small instrumentation script that maps events to the evaluation metrics.

2) Data residency & deletion: for a 4-week POC we can run on our hosted trial environment with US-region tenancy and a signed data handling addendum. If you require dedicated private tenancy or on-prem, that adds operational lead time (we can scope if needed). I'll attach the SLA draft and data handling note for legal.

3) PHI redaction: we recommend you start with anonymized files where possible. If you must send realistic data, Rishi can run an automated redaction pass and provide a sanitized sample back to you; we'll document the process in the POC checklist.

Next steps: please confirm the following so we can lock dates:
- POC kickoff week (I suggested Mar 8 or Mar 15)
- Data owner / contact for access (name/email)
- Security contact for the checklist

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff once we have the owners.

Best,
Marissa

Quick note from the SE side outlining the technical acceptance criteria and pre-kickoff checklist: 
- Acceptance criteria:
  * Ingestion: sample dataset ingest completes (<= 2 hours) and indexing produces embeddings for >=95% of records (exceptions logged).
  * Retrieval accuracy: hits@5 >= 10% improvement over baseline queries provided by you.
  * Latency: P95 < 600ms for enrichment calls under test load (~50 concurrent users).
- Pre-kickoff checklist (what we need from you):
  1) SFTP or secure Drive access to anonymized sample (sized ~5k records)
  2) Contact for API credentials & CRM event mapping (name/email)
  3) Network allowlist: outbound to redwood-inference-prod.* on ports 443; I'll attach a small network-requirements.xlsx with the exact CIDR ranges.

I'll own the technical runbook during the POC and loop in infra if we need a dedicated instance.

Happy to jump on a quick prep call if that helps.
